interpretation: Exact-point pre-loss Thalassia occupancy history remains positively associated with one-year re-recording after stable node identity, community-continuity state, and source-year transect frequency/Braun-Blanquet are controlled. The legacy signal is therefore not explained by current transect-level abundance alone.
ecological_boundary: The remaining history signal is consistent with local ecological legacy, including residual rhizomes/clonal persistence, persistent microsite quality, or repeated local detectability. The monitoring data cannot identify which mechanism generates the history effect.
claim_boundary: Post-hoc saturation audit of an already-opened recovery endpoint.
Do not call the supported history effect direct evidence of clonal memory or residual rhizomes.
Source-year frequency and Braun-Blanquet are transect-level controls and do not capture all point-scale condition.
Return is recorded reappearance at the same meter mark, not genet-level recolonization.
